title: Read-only Business Central visible company context smoke test
goal: Open Business Central read-only, confirm the expected sandbox and company URL context, and try to prove whether the current company is visibly present in shell/page text without opening settings or changing company.
safetyGates: Abort if URL does not contain MCP_1_20260210.
Abort if company URL parameter is not RM-DEMO.
Do not open My Settings or company switch dialogs.
Do not click actions, menus or role-center tiles.
If company is not visible in shell/page text, record notProved instead of forcing navigation.
acceptanceCriteria: Business Central opens with existing storageState.
Instance MCP_1_20260210 is confirmed from URL.
Company RM-DEMO is confirmed from URL parameter.
Visible shell/page text is searched for RM-DEMO without clicking any action.
Result JSON distinguishes URL proof from visible UI proof.
Result JSON contains no-write, no-post, no-preview, no-draft, no-setup-change, no-company-switch, no-settings-open and no-action-click flags.
nextSafeAction: Case ist beobachtet und im State finalisiert. Sichtbarer UI-Company-Nachweis bleibt offen; keine weiteren Shell-Smokes ohne neuen Beweiszweck.

lastResult.summary: LIVE-SMOKE-BC-004 ran read-only in MCP_1_20260210 / RM-DEMO; URL context was correct, but RM-DEMO was not visible in shell/page text without opening settings or actions.
